subject: DynamicTablesPkg: AcpiIortLibArm: Support IORT revision 6
reasons: This is a one-line change replacing a single constant (EFI_ACPI_IO_REMAPPING_TABLE_REVISION_05 to EFI_ACPI_IO_REMAPPING_TABLE_REVISION_06) in one C file at one location.
One-off fixes with a single instance are not good Coccinelle candidates as there is no repetitiveness or scale to justify a semantic patch.
The change requires knowledge of which revision is correct and is not a mechanical, structural transformation.
